title: QUIC server-side 0-RTT admission anti-replay gate verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests with positive, negative, expiry, and fuzz-shaped coverage, followed by SpecTrace, build, full-suite, and diff validation.
scope: Verify that server 0-RTT admission is available only through the internal gate after prior PSK validation, accepted remembered transport parameters, and listener-local one-time ticket consumption while keeping early_data advertisement, server ZeroRtt opening, application delivery, and public support promises closed.
preconditions: The managed listener ticket store contains a live server-issued ticket.
The caller has separately validated the PSK binder for the offered ticket identity.
The remembered transport-parameter snapshot and current server parameters are available for server 0-RTT acceptance checks.
procedure: Run the focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0152 requirement-home tests.
Confirm a validated PSK with acceptable remembered transport parameters consumes a live ticket exactly once.
Confirm replay of the same ticket identity is rejected after the first admission.
Confirm unvalidated PSK and rejected transport-parameter attempts fail before consuming a live ticket.
Confirm expired tickets are rejected and removed from the listener-local store.
Repeat deterministic ticket-identity mutations to prove at most one admission per ticket identity.
expected_result: The internal server 0-RTT admission gate accepts only a validated, transport-parameter-compatible, live same-listener ticket once. Invalid attempts fail closed. early_data advertisement, server ZeroRtt packet opening, application delivery, public API support, HTTP/3, and interop zerortt support remain out of scope.

supplemental_sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
supplemental_sections.content:
- A validated PSK with acceptable remembered transport parameters consumes a live ticket exactly once.
- Replays, unknown tickets, and expired tickets are rejected.
- Unvalidated PSK and transport-parameter-rejected attempts do not consume live tickets.
- The existing 1-RTT resumption ticket lookup remains available.
- early_data advertisement, server ZeroRtt opening, application delivery, public API support, HTTP/3, and interop zerortt promotion remain unchanged.

status_summary: Passed locally for focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0152 requirement-home coverage, including one-time consumption, replay rejection, pre-consumption fail-closed behavior, expiry cleanup, and fuzz-shaped repeated-consumption proof. The final gate passed with SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release no-build test rerun, and diff check. This remains an internal prerequisite only; zerortt stays prerequisite-blocked until early_data ticket advertisement, server ZeroRtt packet opening, and early application-data delivery are implemented and proven.
